description: Capabilities for the main window. Nothing that touches the network or the filesystem is exposed to the webview — every such call goes through a typed RPC command in the Rust core (PLAN §8). start-dragging is the one window verb outside core:default that we need: with titleBarStyle Overlay there is no native title bar, so the data-tauri-drag-region elements in the tab strip are the only way to move the window, and they are dead without it.
